tools.name: latest_posts
tools.description: The newest articles on the AI Training Data Broker blog, optionally only those for sellers (companies selling or licensing their data to AI labs) or buyers (labs sourcing licensed training data). Each result is a title, date, reading time, one-line summary and a link to the full article. Limitation:

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Search the AI Training Data Broker blog by topic, for example "what is my company data worth", "is it legal", "exclusive license", "RL data". Returns matching articles with a one-line summary and a link to the full article. Limitation: plain word matching in English, at most 10 results.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: One article by slug (the last part of its URL) or its full URL: title, date, who it is for, the opening 120 words, the questions its FAQ answers, and a link to read the rest. Use it after a list or search result when the user wants to know what an article says. Limitation: returns the opening, not t

tools.name: search
tools.description: Connector-style search over the blog. Returns ids for fetch. Prefer search_posts for a filtered list.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Connector-style fetch of one article by the id from search. Same opening as get_post.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_posts, get_post · Public sink: get_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_posts, get_post · Public sink: get_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
